Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots (cactuscompute.com)
428 points by HenryNdubuaku 18 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 155 comments

Hey HN,

Henry from Cactus here!

We previously released Cactus Needle, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool call, device use, and structured extraction for phones, wearables, smart homes, small robots and microcontrollers. We got really great feedback here, and have now incorporated the suggestions to release Needle 2.

The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM; 45m parameters at 2bit compression. Needle hits 500 tokens/sec decode speed on a Raspberry Pi 5, sits between 400-1,500 tokens/sec on VR devices like Meta Quest 3S and Apple Vision Pro, and ranges 300-700 on sub-$200 phones such as the Samsung A-Series.

On the tool call and mobile device use benchmarks, Needle 2 trades wins with closest small models like LFM2.5 230M and Apple Foundation Model, at 5x to 70x smaller, both at f16 vs Needle 2 at 2bit. Needle is based on Simple Attention Networks from our paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18363).

Edge AI has lately meant Macs and PCs, but that is just 1.5 billion of over 21 billion connected IoT devices in the world today, and in emerging markets most phones ship under $200, no NPU, cheap GPUs. These include budget phones, Raspberry Pis, microcontrollers, wearables, small robots like Reachy Mini, and connected home devices.

A conventional transformer of Needle's width and depth spends 164 MFLOPs per token, and even one squeezed down to Needle's parameter count spends 87, Needle spends 70. Even on a high-end phone, an always-on assistant lives inside a power budget; every MFLOP is milliwatt-hours, and Needle spends 7x to 85x fewer of them per token than the smallest performant LLMs. More about the architecture in the link.

When we structure intelligence for consumer devices as functions with typed parameters, the only hard part is mapping a messy sentence onto them; which function, with which values. Our research found that when framed that way, the problem needs no world knowledge and no open-ended prose, which is why 45M parameters suffice.

Needle 2 expands to structured extraction where the schema can be passed in-place of tools and the model returns structured output. You can use Needle as a text-classification model with an enum field, as a summarization model by providing a schema that extracts key fields, everything but free-range decode.

Every product has its own tool vocabulary and fine-tuning needle helps it achieve frontier-level performance on custom tasks, so using the python package (https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle), Needle can be fine-tuned Needle on a Mac/PC in minutes to a few hours, with automated data-generation pipeline, just pass a couple samples.

Nonetheless, every response carries a learned confidence score based our Cactus Hybrid technique. If above your threshold, act, below it, escalate to the cloud or bigger model. Combining Needle 2 with a private DeepSeek-v4-Flash deployment works particularly well for enterprise-level tasks at barely any cost, we can help with this setup.

We have put a lot of thoughts into Needle 2 but might still be missing quite a lot, please use the playground in the provided link to test Needle and share your thoughts, always appreciated!

 help

blocks.html_en: We previously released Cactus Needle, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool call, device use, and structured extraction for phones, wearables, smart homes, small robots and microcontrollers. We got really great feedback here, and have now incorporated the suggestions to release Needle 2.

sentences.en: We previously released Cactus Needle, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool call, device use, and structured extraction for phones, wearables, smart homes, small robots and microcontrollers.
sentences.zh: 我们之前发布了 Cactus Needle，这是一个 14MB 的代理法学硕士，用于手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居、小型机器人和微控制器的工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取。

sentences.en: We got really great feedback here, and have now incorporated the suggestions to release Needle 2.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里得到了非常好的反馈，现在已经采纳了发布 Needle 2 的建议。

blocks.html_en: The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM; 45m parameters at 2bit compression. Needle hits 500 tokens/sec decode speed on a Raspberry Pi 5, sits between 400-1,500 tokens/sec on VR devices like Meta Quest 3S and Apple Vision Pro, and ranges 300-700 on sub-$200 phones such as the Samsung A-Series.

sentences.en: The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM; 45m parameters at 2bit compression.
sentences.zh: 整个模型是一个 14MB 的二进制文件，在 28MB RAM 中运行完整的会话； 2 位压缩时 45m 参数。

sentences.en: Needle hits 500 tokens/sec decode speed on a Raspberry Pi 5, sits between 400-1,500 tokens/sec on VR devices like Meta Quest 3S and Apple Vision Pro, and ranges 300-700 on sub-$200 phones such as the Samsung A-Series.
sentences.zh: Needle 在 Raspberry Pi 5 上的解码速度达到 500 个令牌/秒，在 Meta Quest 3S 和 Apple Vision Pro 等 VR 设备上达到 400-1,500 个令牌/秒，在三星 A 系列等 200 美元以下的手机上达到 300-700 个令牌/秒。

blocks.html_en: On the tool call and mobile device use benchmarks, Needle 2 trades wins with closest small models like LFM2.5 230M and Apple Foundation Model, at 5x to 70x smaller, both at f16 vs Needle 2 at 2bit. Needle is based on Simple Attention Networks from our paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18363).

sentences.en: On the tool call and mobile device use benchmarks, Needle 2 trades wins with closest small models like LFM2.5 230M and Apple Foundation Model, at 5x to 70x smaller, both at f16 vs Needle 2 at 2bit.
sentences.zh: 在工具调用和移动设备使用基准测试中，Needle 2 击败了最接近的小型模型，如 LFM2.5 230M 和 Apple Foundation Model，尺寸缩小了 5 到 70 倍，f16 性能对比 Needle 2 2 位性能。

sentences.en: Needle is based on Simple Attention Networks from our paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18363).
sentences.zh: Needle 基于我们论文 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18363) 中的简单注意力网络。

blocks.html_en: Edge AI has lately meant Macs and PCs, but that is just 1.5 billion of over 21 billion connected IoT devices in the world today, and in emerging markets most phones ship under $200, no NPU, cheap GPUs. These include budget phones, Raspberry Pis, microcontrollers, wearables, small robots like Reachy Mini, and connected home devices.

sentences.en: Edge AI has lately meant Macs and PCs, but that is just 1.5 billion of over 21 billion connected IoT devices in the world today, and in emerging markets most phones ship under $200, no NPU, cheap GPUs.
sentences.zh: 边缘人工智能最近指的是 Mac 和 PC，但这只是当今世界超过 210 亿台联网物联网设备中的 15 亿台，而且在新兴市场，大多数手机的售价都在 200 美元以下，没有 NPU，也没有廉价的 GPU。

sentences.en: These include budget phones, Raspberry Pis, microcontrollers, wearables, small robots like Reachy Mini, and connected home devices.
sentences.zh: 其中包括廉价手机、Raspberry Pi、微控制器、可穿戴设备、Reachy Mini 等小型机器人以及联网家庭设备。

blocks.html_en: A conventional transformer of Needle's width and depth spends 164 MFLOPs per token, and even one squeezed down to Needle's parameter count spends 87, Needle spends 70. Even on a high-end phone, an always-on assistant lives inside a power budget; every MFLOP is milliwatt-hours, and Needle spends 7x to 85x fewer of them per token than the smallest performant LLMs. More about the architecture in the link.

sentences.en: A conventional transformer of Needle's width and depth spends 164 MFLOPs per token, and even one squeezed down to Needle's parameter count spends 87, Needle spends 70.
sentences.zh: Needle 的宽度和深度的传统变换器每个令牌花费 164 MFLOP，即使压缩到 Needle 的参数计数也花费 87，Needle 花费 70。

sentences.en: Even on a high-end phone, an always-on assistant lives inside a power budget; every MFLOP is milliwatt-hours, and Needle spends 7x to 85x fewer of them per token than the smallest performant LLMs.
sentences.zh: 即使在高端手机上，永远在线的助手也会在功耗预算之内。每个 MFLOP 是毫瓦时，与最小的高性能 LLM 相比，Needle 每个代币的花费要少 7 到 85 倍。

sentences.en: More about the architecture in the link.
sentences.zh: 有关链接中架构的更多信息。

blocks.html_en: When we structure intelligence for consumer devices as functions with typed parameters, the only hard part is mapping a messy sentence onto them; which function, with which values. Our research found that when framed that way, the problem needs no world knowledge and no open-ended prose, which is why 45M parameters suffice.

sentences.en: When we structure intelligence for consumer devices as functions with typed parameters, the only hard part is mapping a messy sentence onto them; which function, with which values.
sentences.zh: 当我们将消费设备的智能构建为带有类型参数的函数时，唯一困难的部分是将混乱的句子映射到它们上；哪个函数，哪个值。

sentences.en: Our research found that when framed that way, the problem needs no world knowledge and no open-ended prose, which is why 45M parameters suffice.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究发现，当以这种方式构建时，问题不需要世界知识，也不需要开放式的散文，这就是为什么 45M 参数就足够了。

blocks.html_en: Needle 2 expands to structured extraction where the schema can be passed in-place of tools and the model returns structured output. You can use Needle as a text-classification model with an enum field, as a summarization model by providing a schema that extracts key fields, everything but free-range decode.

sentences.en: Needle 2 expands to structured extraction where the schema can be passed in-place of tools and the model returns structured output.
sentences.zh: Needle 2 扩展到结构化提取，其中模式可以代替工具传递，并且模型返回结构化输出。

sentences.en: You can use Needle as a text-classification model with an enum field, as a summarization model by providing a schema that extracts key fields, everything but free-range decode.
sentences.zh: 您可以将 Needle 用作带有枚举字段的文本分类模型，通过提供提取关键字段（除了自由范围解码之外的所有内容）的架构来用作摘要模型。

blocks.html_en: Every product has its own tool vocabulary and fine-tuning needle helps it achieve frontier-level performance on custom tasks, so using the python package (https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle), Needle can be fine-tuned Needle on a Mac/PC in minutes to a few hours, with automated data-generation pipeline, just pass a couple samples.

sentences.en: Every product has its own tool vocabulary and fine-tuning needle helps it achieve frontier-level performance on custom tasks, so using the python package (https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle), Needle can be fine-tuned Needle on a Mac/PC in minutes to a few hours, with automated data-generation pipeline, just pass a couple samples.
sentences.zh: 每个产品都有自己的工具词汇，微调 Needle 有助于其在自定义任务上实现前沿水平的性能，因此使用 python 包（https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle），Needle 可以在几分钟到几个小时内在 Mac/PC 上微调 Needle，具有自动数据生成管道，只需传递几个样本即可。

blocks.html_en: Nonetheless, every response carries a learned confidence score based our Cactus Hybrid technique. If above your threshold, act, below it, escalate to the cloud or bigger model. Combining Needle 2 with a private DeepSeek-v4-Flash deployment works particularly well for enterprise-level tasks at barely any cost, we can help with this setup.

sentences.zh: 尽管如此，每个响应都带有基于我们的仙人掌混合技术的学习置信度分数。

sentences.en: If above your threshold, act, below it, escalate to the cloud or bigger model.
sentences.zh: 如果高于您的阈值，请采取行动，如果低于阈值，请升级到云或更大的模型。

sentences.en: Combining Needle 2 with a private DeepSeek-v4-Flash deployment works particularly well for enterprise-level tasks at barely any cost, we can help with this setup.
sentences.zh: 将 Needle 2 与私有 DeepSeek-v4-Flash 部署相结合特别适用于企业级任务，几乎不需要任何成本，我们可以帮助完成此设置。

content_html_zh: 显示 HN：Needle2：14MB 代理法学硕士，适用于手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人 (cactuscompute.com)428 分，作者：HenryNdubuaku 18 小时前 |隐藏 |过去|最喜欢 | 155 条评论Hey HN，来自 Cactus 的 Henry！我们之前发布了 Cactus Needle，这是一个 14MB 的代理 LLM，用于手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居、小型机器人和微控制器的工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取。 我们在这里得到了非常好的反馈，现在已经采纳了发布 Needle 2 的建议。整个模型是一个 14MB 的二进制文件，在 28MB RAM 中运行一个完整的会话； 2 位压缩时 45m 参数。 Needle 在 Raspberry Pi 5 上达到 500 个令牌/秒的解码速度，在 Meta Quest 3S 和 Apple Vision Pro 等 VR 设备上达到 400-1,500 个令牌/秒，在三星 A 系列等 200 美元以下的手机上达到 300-700 个令牌/秒。在工具调用和移动设备使用基准测试中，Needle 2 击败了最接近的小型模型，如 LFM2.5 230M 和 Apple Foundation Model， f16 与 Needle 2 2 位相比，小 5 至 70 倍。 Needle 基于我们论文 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18363) 中的简单注意力网络。边缘 AI 最近意味着 Mac 和 PC，但这只是当今世界上超过 210 亿个联网物联网设备中的 15 亿台，而在新兴市场，大多数手机的售价低于 200 美元，没有 NPU，廉价的 GPU。 其中包括经济型手机、Raspberry Pi、微控制器、可穿戴设备、Reachy Mini 等小型机器人以及联网家庭设备。Needle 宽度和深度的传统变压器每个代币花费 164 MFLOP，甚至压缩到 Needle 的参数数也花费 87，Needle 花费 70。 即使在高端手机上，永远在线的助手也会在功耗预算之内。每个 MFLOP 是毫瓦时，与最小的高性能 LLM 相比，Needle 每个代币的花费要少 7 到 85 倍。 有关链接中架构的更多信息。当我们将消费设备的智能构建为具有类型参数的函数时，唯一困难的部分是将混乱的句子映射到它们上；哪个函数，哪个值。 我们的研究发现，以这种方式构建时，问题不需要世界知识，也不需要开放式散文，这就是为什么 45M 参数就足够了。Needle 2 扩展到结构化提取，其中模式可以代替工具传递，并且模型返回结构化输出。 您可以将 Needle 用作带有枚举字段的文本分类模型，通过提供提取关键字段（除了自由范围解码之外的所有内容）的模式来用作摘要模型。每个产品都有自己的工具词汇表，并且微调 Needle 有助于其在自定义任务上实现前沿级别的性能，因此使用 python 包（https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle），Needle 可以在几分钟到几个小时内在 Mac/PC 上微调 Needle，并自动生成数据管道，只需传递几个样本。尽管如此，每个响应都带有基于我们的仙人掌混合技术的学习置信度分数。 如果高于您的阈值，请采取行动，如果低于阈值，请升级到云或更大的模型。 将 Needle 2 与私有 DeepSeek-v4-Flash 部署相结合特别适用于企业级任务，几乎不需要任何成本，我们可以帮助完成此设置。我们在 Needle 2 中投入了很多想法，但可能仍然缺少很多，请使用提供的链接中的 Playground 来测试 Needle 并分享您的想法，非常感谢！ 帮助
